Jak zapisać lub wczytać zestaw?: How do I save or load a build?
Zapisz zestaw, aby później do niego wróc: Save a build to return to it later or compare it with another one.
Zapis lokalny pozostaje w tej przeglądar: Local saves stay in this browser. Download a file to move your build to another device or keep a copy after clearing browser data.
Kliknij „Zapisz lokalnie”. Zestaw znajdz: Click “Save locally”. You will find the build under Local builds.
Aby zachować kopię poza przeglądarką, wy: To keep a copy outside your browser, export the saved build to a file.
Użyj „Wczytaj build”, aby otworzyć plik: Use “Load build” to open an app file or a Broken HUD export. On a phone, saving and loading are in the Build menu.

Doradca: szukaj ulepszeń aktualnego zest: Advisor: find improvements to your current build within the changes you allow.

Jak korzystać z Doradcy?: How do I use the Advisor?
Doradca proponuje konkretne działania po: The Advisor suggests specific actions to improve your current build.
Przygotuj aktualny zestaw w kreatorze i: Prepare your current build in the builder and choose Advisor in the optimizer.
Wskaż bonus do poprawy oraz sprawdź ochr: Choose the bonus to improve and review protections for the other bonuses.
Wybierz dozwolone zmiany, np. ulepszanie: Choose allowed changes, such as upgrading drifs or increasing stars. Lock anything you want to keep unchanged.
Uruchom analizę i porównaj proponowane d: Run the analysis and compare the suggested actions and their effects.
Jak przełożyć posiadane drify?: How do I rearrange my drifs?
Reorganizacja szuka miejsca dla wybranej: Reorganization uses your owned drifs to find room for a selected operation.
Wskaż kamienie do ulepszenia lub wstawie: Select the stones to upgrade or insert, or the item where you need space.
Sprawdź ochrony bonusów i blokady, a nas: Review bonus protections and locks, then start the search.
Przejrzyj instrukcję przełożeń. Zastosuj: Review the move instructions. Apply the result if it meets your needs.
Dlaczego drif nie mieści się w przedmioc: Why does a drif not fit in an item?
Drify obrażeń od ognia, zimna i energii: Fire, frost and energy damage drifs only fit in weapons. A weapon can contain only one of these three types.
Sprawdź, czy tier przedmiotu dopuszcza w: Check whether the item tier allows the selected drif size.
Upewnij się, że w tym przedmiocie nie ma: Make sure the item does not already contain a drif with the same bonus type.
Jak zaplanować rozwój ekwipunku?: How do I plan equipment progression?
Ścieżka rozwoju pokazuje kolejne etapy p: The progression path shows the stages leading to your target build.
Wczytaj lub przygotuj docelowy zestaw w: Load or prepare your target build in the Progression path view.
Ustaw profesję i docelowy poziom. W razi: Set your profession and target level. If needed, adjust the gap between item replacements and balanced stat progression.
Wygeneruj ścieżkę. Rozwijaj kolejne etap: Generate the path. Expand each stage to see items and instructions for moving and upgrading stones.
Zapisz projekt do pliku, aby później wró: Save the project to a file to return to planning later.
Blokada slotu zachowuje jego obecną konf: A slot lock keeps its current configuration unchanged. An individual drif lock keeps it in the same socket.
Chroniony bonus nie może spaść poniżej u: A protected bonus cannot fall below its set minimum. Any allowed loss is measured from the value capped at its useful limit.

Set your level and character points.
Tryb prosty korzysta z gotowych ustawień: Simple mode uses presets for your selected profession. In advanced mode, you set bonus priorities, percentage targets and drif limits yourself.
Wybierz zapisany build, aby go wczytać,: Select a saved build to load it, download it as a file or rename it.
Zaznacz 2 lub 3 buildy do porównania. Pr: Select 2 or 3 builds to compare. Switch between the equipment, character and orbs, and drifs tabs. Enable “Tables: differences only” to hide matching values.
„Nadpisz” zastępuje zapisany build aktua: “Overwrite” replaces the saved build with your current setup. Overwriting and deleting require a second click to confirm.
Ten tryb dobiera rozmieszczenie i poziom: This mode chooses drif placements and levels. Prepare your items, stars and orbs in the builder first.
W trybie prostym wybierz profesję i pref: In simple mode, choose a profession and your preferred counts of damage and accuracy drifs. These are preferences: the result may use different counts.
W trybie zaawansowanym ustaw priorytety: In advanced mode, set bonus priorities, minimum and maximum drif counts, and allowed sizes.
„Dąż do capa” i „Wymuś %” wskazują pożąd: “Aim for cap” and “Force %” set desired bonus values. If they cannot be reached, you receive the best valid setup found with a warning.
Check your locks and run optimization. A valid result is applied to your setup immediately.
Zablokuj slot, aby zachować cały przedmi: Lock a slot to keep the entire item, including its stars, orb and drifs.
Zablokuj pojedynczy drif, aby zachować g: Lock an individual drif to keep it at the same level and in the same socket.
W Doradcy i Reorganizacji chroń bonusy,: In Advisor and Reorganization, protect bonuses that should not decrease. You can allow a specific loss; the result must keep the resulting minimum.
Dopuszczalna strata liczy się najwyżej o: Allowed loss is measured from at most the cap, the highest useful bonus value. For example, a 60% cap, a current value of 62% and an allowed loss of 3 percentage points give a minimum of 57%.
Sprawdź status i ostrzeżenia. Nieosiągni: Check the status and warnings. A valid result may miss a percentage target; the report shows the shortfall.
W trybie Od zera i w Reorganizacji popra: In Build from scratch and Reorganization, a valid result is applied automatically. In Advisor, choose a proposal and click its apply button.
Jeśli są dostępne warianty, porównaj ich: If variants are available, compare their bonuses and changes. Selecting a variant only opens a preview; use the apply button to change your setup.
W Reorganizacji przejrzyj kolejność prze: In Reorganization, review the order of moves and upgrades. In Advisor, check the action list and bonus gains and losses.
Poprawny wynik zostanie zastosowany auto: A valid result is applied automatically. Review the move instructions; use “Undo reorganization” if needed.
W zaawansowanej konfiguracji Od zera moż: In advanced Build from scratch settings, you can use individual drifs stored in your backpack.
W plecaku zaznacz drify do użycia w opty: Select backpack drifs for use in optimization. Drifs embedded in spare items are not considered.
Włącz „Użyj drifów z plecaka”. Optymaliz: Enable “Use backpack drifs”. The optimizer first finds a target layout, then matches owned drifs of the same type and size.
Posiadany drif trafia do zestawu ze swoi: An owned drif enters the setup at its current level. The report also shows its target upgrade level. A missing drif remains in the result as a stone to acquire.
Po zastosowaniu wyniku użyte drify znika: Applying the result removes used drifs from your backpack and returns replaced ordinary drifs to it. Each owned drif can only be used once.
„Pomijaj zmianę ekwipunku co X poziom” o: “Skip equipment changes every X levels” limits replacement frequency in each slot separately. Enter 0 to keep every stage. Target items, the epic and the legendary weapon stay in the plan.
„Równomierny rozwój statystyk” wyrównuje: “Balanced stat progression” balances drif bonus progress relative to their target values. The final setup stays the same.
„Blokada pod resy” rezerwuje wybrane pie: “Reserve slots for res” reserves selected ring or necklace slots. The plan skips these slots and adds no stats for unspecified res items.
W liście zakupów wybierz wszystkie niewy: In the shopping list, choose all unfinished stages or the next three. Check off prepared items and download the TXT list. Preparing an item and completing a stage are marked separately.
Każdy poziom powyżej 1 daje 4 punkty do: Each level above 1 gives 4 points to distribute across attributes. One point adds 10 health, mana or stamina, or 1 to another attribute.
„Zresetuj punkty” zwraca cały przydział: “Reset points” returns all allocated points to the pool. After editing, click “Calculate stats” to refresh the result.
Gwiazdki zwiększają bazowe statystyki pr: Stars increase an item’s base stats. Orb bonuses increase from 4★, and drif bonuses from 7★.
Przy niezerowej bazowej pojemności 7★ da: For items with nonzero base capacity, 7★ adds 1 capacity, 8★ adds 2, and 9★ adds 4. These increases are relative to a 1★ item.
Przedmioty tieru II i III od 7★ otrzymuj: Tier II and III items gain a second drif socket at 7★. In other tiers, stars do not add ordinary sockets.
Przedmioty epickie i setowe mają ustalon: Epic and set items have fixed drif types. The editor lets you choose their levels without changing their types or moving these stones.
Wliczają się do liczby drifów danego typ: They count towards drif type totals and the repetition penalty. The optimizer also includes them in stone count limits.
Ten sam typ bonusu orba może wystąpić ty: Each orb bonus type can appear only once in the entire setup. The orb size must fit the item tier.
Broń przyjmuje orby ofensywne; tarcza of: Weapons accept offensive orbs; shields accept offensive or defensive ones. Helmets, armor, pants and boots accept defensive orbs, capes, belts and gloves offensive orbs, and rings and necklaces utility orbs.
Legenda mieści dwa orby. Pierwszy pasuje: A legendary item holds two orbs. The first fits the slot category or is offensive; the second must be offensive. Their bonuses must differ.
Suborb ma poziom 1, pozostałe rozmiary m: A suborb has level 1; other sizes reach level 3. Orbs benefit from stars and do not consume drif capacity.
„max lvl orby” ustawia najwyższe poziomy: “max lvl orbs” sets the highest levels of equipped orbs. “max lvl drifs” does the same for equipped drifs, taking capacity into account.
Jeśli wszystkie drify nie mieszczą się n: If all drifs do not fit at maximum levels, some receive a lower level. A message identifies the affected stones.
Przyciski zachowują typy i rozmiary kami: These buttons keep stone types and sizes.
Po zmianie zestawu kliknij „Przelicz sta: After editing the setup, click “Calculate stats”. Tabs let you browse base stats, orbs and drifs. Click a value to see its sources.
Od czwartego drifa tego samego typu dzia: From the fourth drif of the same type, a repetition penalty reduces their combined effect. Built-in drifs also count; orbs are not affected by this penalty.
The cap is the highest useful bonus value. Excess above it gives no further benefit. For mana and stamina usage reduction, a more negative value means a stronger reduction.
W szczegółach sprawdzisz bonus przedmiot: Details show item bonuses, stars and multipliers. Components are displayed to 4 decimal places; the result is rounded after summing.
Przedmioty wyszukasz po nazwie lub bossi: Search items by name or boss, regardless of letter case. Filters narrow results by category, tier and base stat.
W wyszukiwaniu przedmiotów możesz łączyć: In item search, you can join names with |, for example Morana|Tarul. An invalid expression shows an error beside the field; correct it or clear the filters.
Użyj „Dodaj”, wybierz przedmiot, drif lu: Use “Add”, choose an item, drif or orb and set its parameters in the editor. “Duplicate” creates a separate entry with the same configuration.
Plecak mieści 200 wpisów. Przedmiot z os: The backpack holds 200 entries. An item with embedded stones takes one entry; each individual drif or orb takes another.
Strzałki przesuwania działają przy sorto: Move arrows work with “Custom order” sorting. With other sorting modes, the selected criterion determines each entry’s position.
„Wymaga poprawy” oznacza niepoprawną kon: “Needs fixing” marks an invalid entry configuration. Select it, check the editor message and correct the indicated parameters.
„Zdejmij wszystkie przedmioty” przenosi: “Remove all items” moves them to the backpack with their embedded stones. “Remove all orbs” and “Remove all drifs” store stones as individual entries.
Ikona plecaka przy przedmiocie lub kamie: The backpack icon beside an item or stone removes only that object.
Strzałka obok przycisku cofa konkretną o: The arrow beside the button undoes that specific operation. Undo is available while the transferred object and its former location remain unchanged.
„Cofnij” przywraca poprzedni stan buildu: “Undo” restores the previous build state, and “Redo” reapplies an undone change. A new edit after undo starts a new history branch.
Użyj Ctrl+Z, aby cofnąć, oraz Ctrl+Shift: Use Ctrl+Z to undo, and Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y to redo. On Mac, use Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z. While typing, shortcuts apply to the field being edited.
Historia jest dostępna podczas bieżącej: History is available during the current session. To keep a version for later, save the build or download a file.
„Opis bonusu” pokazuje nazwę efektu, a „: “Bonus description” shows the effect name, while “Drif name” shows the stone name. Choose whichever is easier to recognize in settings and reports.
Wyszukiwanie modów rozpoznaje oba rodzaj: Modifier search recognizes both kinds of names. The choice is remembered in your browser and does not change calculations or the setup configuration.
Profil profesji dobiera gotowy zestaw pr: A profession profile selects preset priorities. Changing profession restores the new profile’s defaults, so check your preferred drif counts again.
Rycerz i Druid mają styl ofensywny i def: Knight and Druid have offensive and defensive styles. Changing style updates default drif counts while preserving custom counts; defensive style enables passive damage reduction.
Barbarzyńca wybiera żywioł drifa w broni: Barbarian selects an elemental drif for the weapon. Sheed can choose an element or “No element”.
Włączenie redukcji obrażeń biernych lub: Enabling passive or percentage damage reduction requires one drif of that type. Archer, Sheed and Voodoo can also enable Holm or Farid, adding a requirement for the respective drif.
Dodaj bonusy, które mają być brane pod u: Add the bonuses to consider. A weight from 1 to 30 sets their relative importance: higher weight rewards improving that bonus more strongly.
Waga nie jest docelowym procentem ani gw: Weight is not a target percentage or a guarantee of a particular value. Set percentage targets separately.
„Potencjalny zakres” to szacunek dla dan: “Potential range” estimates a bonus on the selected equipment with its drif count limits. Bonuses share sockets and capacity, so not all maxima can be reached together.
Sortowanie i ukrywanie kategorii porządk: Sorting and hiding categories organizes the view. Hidden priorities still participate in calculations; “Show all” restores their visibility.
Minimalna i maksymalna liczba drifów są: Minimum and maximum drif counts are hard requirements for a bonus across the entire setup. Locked and built-in drifs also count.
W „Rozmiarach drifów” włącz ograniczenie: In “Drif sizes”, enable a constraint for a size and set its range. “Any” means no separate constraint for that size; the total count limit still applies.
Maksimum 0 wyklucza zwykłe drify danego: A maximum of 0 excludes ordinary drifs of that size. A mandatory built-in drif exceeding the size maximum is kept with a warning, without allowing additional drifs of that size.
Zakresy muszą być spójne z limitem łączn: Ranges must agree with the total limit, locks, tier and capacity. Conflicting limits require correcting the settings before a valid setup can be produced.
„Maksymalizuj mod” wskazuje bonus do uzy: “Maximize modifier” requests the highest useful value of a bonus. The optimizer must still respect drif count limits, locks and capacity.
„Wymuś maksymalizację według bonusów do: “Force maximization by drif bonuses” first reserves positions for maximized modifiers on items with the highest drif bonuses. Enable it after selecting modifiers to maximize. Reserving positions this way limits placement freedom for other drifs.
„Obliczaj dodatkowe warianty” w zaawanso: “Calculate additional variants” in advanced Build from scratch searches for alternatives that improve selected bonuses at the expense of others. It is unavailable when using backpack drifs.
Maksymalna strata określa dopuszczalny s: Maximum loss limits the decrease in each of the other evaluated bonuses in percentage points. With a 10% bonus and a 5 pp limit, the allowed minimum is 5%.
Większy limit dopuszcza większe kompromi: A larger limit permits greater trade-offs. A variant must still satisfy equipment rules, locks and hard limits.
Wybór wariantu pokazuje podgląd. Kliknij: Selecting a variant opens a preview. Click “Apply selected variant” to transfer it to the setup. Manual build changes may require running optimization again.
„Zapisz” przy priorytetach pobiera plik: “Save” beside priorities downloads optimizer settings: priorities, targets, limits and mode options. Save equipment separately as a build.
„Wczytaj” zastępuje konfigurację ustawie: “Load” replaces the configuration with settings from that file. After import, check the mode, targets and limits for the current equipment.
„Wyczyść” usuwa wszystkie priorytety, ta: “Clear” removes all priorities, including those hidden by category filters. Other mode settings are kept.
„Największa poprawa” szuka największego: “Largest improvement” seeks the greatest gain in the main bonus. “Reach a value” sets a target result, while “Gain a number of pp” sets an increase relative to the current result. For example, with a current value of 20%, a target of 25% and a gain of 5 pp request the same value. Check the field’s unit before starting analysis.
„Nie premiuj wzrostu ponad zadany cel” k: “Do not reward growth above the target” stops rewarding the main bonus at the target. A higher result is still allowed, but excess alone does not improve the plan’s score.
„Najmniejsza ingerencja” po osiągnięciu: After reaching the target, “Minimum change” prefers fewer purchases and upgrades. “Best result” prioritizes a greater useful effect, even with more changes.
„Profil buildu” dobiera profil zamiennik: “Build profile” selects the profile of replacement items: magical or physical. “Automatic” infers it from current equipment and character attributes.
Zaznacz, czy Doradca może podnosić gwiaz: Choose whether Advisor may raise stars, upgrade drifs, or buy drifs or items. Disabled options will not appear in proposed actions.
Przekładanie i zamiana posiadanych drifó: Moving and swapping owned drifs remain available when purchases and upgrades are disabled. Locks let you preserve selected positions.
Zakres zakupów drifów dopuszcza tylko gł: The drif purchase scope allows only the main modifier, the main and protected modifiers, or any modifier. A broader scope gives more ways to improve the result and maintain protections.
Limit od 1 do 10 działań określa długość: A limit from 1 to 10 actions sets the plan length. Moving a drif, swapping two drifs, or purchasing or upgrading one object counts as one action.
Budżet 3 lub 6 sekund ogranicza wyszukiw: A 3- or 6-second budget limits the search. More time or actions may reveal other plans, but the result can still be the best found without proof that it is the best possible.
„Zatrzymaj i pokaż znalezione plany” koń: “Stop and show found plans” ends the search and returns verified proposals. The list may be empty if no improvement has been confirmed yet.
Po zmianie ekwipunku, atrybutów lub blok: After changing equipment, attributes or locks, run analysis again. An old proposal may no longer fit the edited setup.
W „Ulepsz drify” wybierz założone kamien: In “Upgrade drifs”, choose equipped stones and their target sizes and levels. You can add multiple upgrades; all must fit at the same time.
Przy jednym ulepszanym kamieniu „Szukaj: For a single upgraded stone, “Find highest level” searches up to the specified maximum. The result may keep the current level if no higher level could be fitted.
W „Wstaw drif” wskaż konkretne osobne sz: In “Insert drif”, select specific individual backpack stones. Their “For optimization” checkbox is not required for this task.
Wybierz przedmiot docelowy albo „Dowolny: Choose a target item or “Any suitable item”. You can also add upgrades of equipped drifs; all insertions and upgrades must be satisfied together.
„Zwolnij miejsce” wymaga wskazanej liczb: “Free space” requires the specified free sockets and free capacity in the selected item. If you set both requirements, the result must satisfy both together.
Limit przełożeń wynosi od 1 do 50. Przen: The move limit ranges from 1 to 50. Moving, inserting or storing a stone counts as 1, swapping two stones as 2, and upgrading without moving as 0.
„Pozwól odkładać założone drify do pleca: “Allow equipped drifs to be stored in the backpack” permits removing some stones. Selected upgrades and insertions remain mandatory, and protected bonuses must keep their minima.
Wykonuj przełożenia w kolejności raportu: Follow the report order for removals, moves, insertions and upgrades.
Raport wskazuje dodatkowe miejsca potrze: The report shows extra backpack space needed for that operation order. The instruction count may differ from the move limit, which counts final placement changes.
„Cofnij reorganizację” przywraca stan sp: “Undo reorganization” restores the state before applying the result. Later changes to the setup or involved backpack objects may block undo; a message gives the reason.
„Pobierz całą bibliotekę” zapisuje wszys: “Download entire library” saves all local builds in one file.
Przy każdym wpisie wybierz dodanie, doda: For each entry, choose add, add a copy, skip, or replace a specific build. Replacing overwrites the contents of the existing save.
Biblioteka mieści 10 buildów. Podgląd po: The library holds 10 builds. The preview shows the count after import; if the limit is exceeded, skip entries or replace existing ones. Confirm with “Import selected builds”.
Zaznacz 2 lub 3 zapisane buildy. Zakładk: Select 2 or 3 saved builds. Tabs show equipment, character and orbs, and drif composition; “Tables: differences only” hides matching rows.
Kolumny pokazują wartości zapisane dla k: Columns show the values saved for each build. Highlighting the best value takes caps and the negative direction of resource usage reductions into account.
„—” oznacza brak zapisanej statystyki. W: “—” means a saved stat is missing. Load that build, calculate stats and overwrite the save to fill in comparison data.
„Twój poziom” pomaga wskazać najbliższy: “Your level” helps identify the nearest unfinished stage. Expand its card to check objects to prepare, upgrade and move.
„Wykonane” odhacza cały etap. Przygotowa: “Completed” checks off an entire stage. Mark prepared purchases separately in the shopping list; preparing an object alone does not complete the stage.
Poziom i odhaczenia są zapamiętywane w t: Your level and checkmarks are remembered in this browser. Recreate the plan when you return. A changed target or different plan may require marking progress again; the app shows a message.
„Pozostałe wolne drify” to kamienie, któ: “Remaining free drifs” are stones left outside the final equipment after the plan’s operations. Check their sizes and levels in the expandable list.
„Pobierz projekt” zapisuje cel, profesję: “Download project” saves the target, profession and path settings, including res reservations. Generate the plan again after loading the project.
Odhaczenia etapów i zakupów są przechowy: Stage and purchase checkmarks are stored separately in your browser. The project file transfers planning inputs rather than the completion checklist.
„Eksportuj ekwipunek etapu” pobiera zwyk: “Export stage equipment” downloads a normal build file with the final equipment for that level. You can load it in the builder.
W jednym przedmiocie nie można powtórzyć: A drif bonus type cannot repeat within one item. If sockets or capacity are insufficient, check stars or use Reorganization.
Bieżąca praca jest zachowywana jako szki: Current work is kept as a browser draft. “Save locally” creates a separate library entry that you can return to independently of later draft changes.
Wybierz docelowy build z aktualnego krea: Choose a target build from the current builder, library or a file. Selection captures a copy; after builder edits, select the source again to update the target.
„Cofnij” przywraca poprzedni stan buildu: “Undo” restores the previous build state, and “Redo” reapplies an undone change. A new edit after undo clears the redo history.
Wybierz Plecak jako źródło wyposażenia,: Select Backpack as the equipment source, choose an object and a suitable slot or socket. On desktop, you can also drag it to the desired location.
Przedmiot zakładasz razem z jego orbami: You equip an item together with its orbs and drifs. The replaced item returns to the backpack with its own orbs and drifs. Swapping a single stone returns only that stone.
Drif lub orb musi pasować do wybranego g: A drif or orb must fit the selected socket and comply with the game rules. Built-in drifs cannot be replaced with backpack stones; an invalid swap shows a message explaining why.
Historia obejmuje ekwipunek, plecak, atr: History covers equipment, the backpack, character attributes, and slot and drif locks.
Łączna potęga przedmiotu po tej zmianie:: Total power used in the item after this change: {0}/{1}.
Sprawdź zużytą pojemność przedmiotu. Pod: Check the item’s used capacity. Increasing a drif’s level can increase its power and capacity requirement.
W zakładkach orbów i drifów wybierz kate: In the orb and drif tabs, choose a bonus category. The drif power filter uses base power; set the level after choosing the stone.
Potęga drifa rośnie na poziomach 7, 12 i: Drif power increases at levels 7, 12 and 17. A larger size at the same bonus type and level does not increase capacity use.
Suma potęg wszystkich zwykłych drifów mu: The combined power of all ordinary drifs must fit within the item capacity.
Mniejsze rozmiary drifów też pasują. Mak: Smaller drif sizes also fit. The table shows maximum sizes and their levels.
Rozmiar i poziom drifa według tieru: Drif size and level by item tier
Rozmiar i poziom orba według tieru: Orb size and level by item tier
